recalled.item: solar age 4.6 Gyr, M_sun = 1.989e33 g, R_sun = 6.9634e10 cm (WimPyC values)
AGSS09ph standard solar model composition/density profile (as shipped with WimPyC); rho_c ~ 150 g/cm3, T_c = 1.4e7 K
recalled.presumed_source: Serenelli, Basu, Ferguson, Asplund, ApJL 705, L123 (2009) via WimPyC

recalled.item: local DM density 0.3-0.4 GeV/cm3 (we use 0.4 as P039; 0.3 shown as variation)
recalled.presumed_source: Baxter et al. 2021 / de Salas & Widmark 2021

recalled.item: Sommerfeld enhancement of Higgsino WW/ZZ at v ~ 1e-3 c is O(1-3); dark-photon saturation S_sat = 6 alpha_D m/m_A'
solar evaporation mass ~ 3-4 GeV for elastic WIMPs
IceCube 2016-2022 solar WIMP searches (IC79/86, 3-7 yr): at 1 TeV sigma_SD(W+W-) ~ 1e-41 - 1e-40 cm^2, sigma_SI ~ 1e-43 cm^2; tau tau similar, b bbar ~30x weaker
recalled.presumed_source: IceCube, EPJC 77, 146 (2017); IceCube PRD 105, 062004 (2022) [low mass]; JCAP 04 (2016) 022

recalled.item: ANTARES 11-yr solar WIMP limits: sigma_SD(W+W-, 1 TeV) ~ 1e-40 cm^2 (few e-41 - 3e-40)
Super-K solar WIMP search covers m <= 200 GeV (sigma_SD ~ 1e-39 at 200 GeV, b bbar); no TeV reach
channel scaling of solar limits at 1 TeV: tau tau ~ W+W- (x1-2), b bbar ~ 20-50x weaker; A'A'->4 tau at E_A' = m_chi behaves like tau tau at m_chi/2 with 2xBR(tau) yield
recalled.presumed_source: IceCube 2017 channel comparison; Batell-Pospelov-Ritz-Shang 2010 (secluded DM in the Sun)

recalled.item: a direct nu nubar line is ~3x more constraining than tau tau per annihilation at TeV energies (absorption in the Sun limits the gain)
recalled.presumed_source: IceCube/ANTARES channel comparisons; Rott, Siegal-Gaskins, Beacom 2011

recalled.item: muon range in the solar core: dE/dx ~ 2 MeV g^-1 cm^2 x 150 g/cm3 -> a 500 GeV muon stops in ~20 m, far below its 3e6 m decay length; pi/K likewise stop -> only tau, c, b give hard neutrinos
